subject.title: Feature: Granular Discord action gates (split actions.messages into read/edit/delete)

question: What permanent Discord permission shape and precedence should govern send, read/fetch, edit, and delete while preserving existing `actions.messages` configurations?
rationale: This adds a public security-sensitive config contract, and source inspection cannot decide whether granular overrides should be Discord-specific, generic across channel actions, or how omitted values and aliases should inherit.

options.title: Add inherited per-action overrides
options.body: Keep the existing boolean as the group default and allow explicit send/read/edit/delete overrides whose values take precedence, with fetch mapped to read and all enforcement using one resolver.

options.title: Create a generic action policy
options.body: Introduce a channel-independent allow/deny action policy and migrate Discord message gates onto it, accepting a broader API and implementation scope.

options.title: Retain the coarse gate
options.body: Keep the current boolean-only model and document that deployments must use Discord-side permissions or tool policy for finer restrictions.

recommendation.title: Add inherited per-action overrides
recommendation.body: Keep the existing boolean as the group default and allow explicit send/read/edit/delete overrides whose values take precedence, with fetch mapped to read and all enforcement using one resolver.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly assigns the Discord subsystem to this owner, and the choice defines Discord's public permission and compatibility contract.
